season.evidence: Peakbagger successful ascents of Magic: Jun 1, Jul 27, Aug 17, Sep 3 (none later). A search of the Mountaineers route listing (open Apr-Oct, no best month) and a forecast site (Jun-Oct) agrees with Jul-Sep; stored Jul-Sep kept. South Ridge is the route logged in Sep (S Ridge).

track.why: Trip report describes the camp at Kool-Aid Lake, the col between Magic and Hurry-up, the steep meadow, the ridge scramble and a class 4 summit tower - exactly the stored South Ridge line - and the track follows it from the Cascade Pass trailhead (9 m from our pin) to the camp and the summit (43 m from our pin), summited Aug 8. Ends at camp, hence oneway.

facts.text: Steep, icy snow finger on the traverse below the Cache Glacier in early August: kick steps or drop to lower-angle scree beneath it.
crampons (icy snow patch on the approach traverse, July to early August)
Above the col, the ridge scramble sometimes drops off the crest and climbs back on; if it gets harder than class 3, you have wandered off-route.
The summit tower has one or two class 4 moves on far sounder rock than the loose ground leading to it.
Water at Kool-Aid Lake is plentiful in early August but tastes stale, so treat it.
